briefings.title: From 'polycrisis' to 'polytunity' - the future of geopolitics with Prof Yuen Yuen Ang

people.name: Yuen Yuen Ang
people.role: Political Science Professor, Johns Hopkins University

briefings.tldr: The global "polycrisis" is actually a "polytunity"—a moment of systemic breakdown that forces structural transformation, particularly as power shifts from Western-led norms to the global majority.
